title: 第268章 陈司长的建议
slug: 德黑兰杂货铺我的情报明码标价
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

杜坚很清楚苏莱曼的意思。

利刃这边本来就少一个人，雷子现在又挂了彩。

哈桑虽然也满脸是血，但苏莱曼那边还有好几个无伤的战斗人员。

老K专精电子战，真要上去肉搏，根本不够看。

再加上疯子刚才在自己最擅长的领域栽了跟头，士气受挫。

这种局面下硬拼第三场，毫无胜算。

苏莱曼主动提议改天，是把台阶递到了脚底下。

杜坚深吸了一口气，压下心头那点不甘。

“行。”

听到这个字，苏莱曼表情缓和下来，咧开嘴笑了。

他往前迈了一步，宽大的手掌拍在杜坚肩膀上。

“你们的实力也很强，等你们的人都到齐了，咱们再比过。”

苏莱曼挥了挥手。

“收了吧。”

塔里克和亚辛立刻上前，把散落在地上的枪械收进木箱。

苏莱曼则拽着还在瞪着雷子的哈桑，朝宿舍的方向走去。

杜坚转过身，带着老K和疯子，走到张剑跟前。

“张老板，你手底下这帮人的安保力量确实强，我们甘拜下风。”

杜坚语气坦然，输了就是输了，找借口不是他的作风。

张剑笑了笑。

“不至于。”

“你们都很强，只是他们在这边摸爬滚打的时间长，经验更丰富一点。”

“而且你们今天人数也吃亏，真要拉开架势打，胜负难料。”

杜坚没反驳，点点头算是承了这个人情。

“不过张老板，陈司长的意思你也清楚。”

杜坚话锋一转，切入正题。

“我们的任务，就是负责你的安全。”

“虽然目前这比试我们暂时输了，但任务还得继续。”

“麻烦你给我们安排个住处，方便我们随时跟进。”

“这些好说。”

张剑答应得很痛快。

他转头看向旁边的赵平安。

“赵哥旁边那几间屋子空着，你们住那边就行。”

“缺什么少什么，直接来找我。”

与张剑分开。

赵平安带着杜坚几个人穿过院子，来到他的宿舍旁。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Du Jian knew exactly what Suleiman meant.

There was already one less person on Sharp Blade's side, but now Lei Zi has failed again.

Although Hassan's face was also covered in blood, there were still several uninjured combatants on Suleiman's side.

Lao K specializes in electronic warfare. If he really wants to fight hand-to-hand, it's not enough to watch.

In addition, the lunatic just failed in the field he was best at, and his morale was dampened.

In this situation, there is no chance of winning in the third game.

Suleiman took the initiative to suggest another day, handing the steps to his feet.

Du Jian took a deep breath and suppressed the unwillingness in his heart.

"Okay."

Hearing this word, Suleiman's expression softened and he grinned.

He took a step forward and patted Du Jian's shoulder with his broad palm.

"You are also very strong. When all your people are here, we will compete again."

Suleiman waved his hand.

"Take it."

Tariq and Yasin immediately stepped forward and put the firearms scattered on the ground into wooden boxes.

Suleiman dragged Hassan, who was still staring at Lei Zi, towards the dormitory.

Du Jian turned around, led Old K and Madman, and walked to Zhang Jian.

"Boss Zhang, the security force of your people is indeed strong. We are willing to give in."

Du Jian's tone was calm. If he loses, he loses. Making excuses is not his style.

Zhang Jian smiled.

"Not really."

"You are all very strong, but they have been here for a long time and have more experience."

"Besides, you are also at a disadvantage in terms of numbers today. If we really have to get up to speed and fight, the outcome will be unpredictable."

Du Jian didn't refute, and nodded to accept the favor.

"But Boss Zhang, you also know what Director Chen means."

Du Jian changed the topic and got to the point.

"Our mission is to be responsible for your safety."

"Although we have temporarily lost this competition, the mission must continue."

"Please arrange a place for us to stay so that we can follow up at any time."

"These are easy to talk about."

Zhang Jian agreed happily.

He turned to look at Zhao Pingan next to him.

"The rooms next to Brother Zhao are empty, you can just live there."

"If you are missing anything, just come to me directly."

Separate from Zhang Jian.

Zhao Ping'an led Du Jian and others across the yard to his dormitory.
